tipMainDestination: Where the converted files are written
msgDstHint: Leave it empty to write beside each file. A full path is one folder for every file. A relative folder such as convert, .\convert or ..\convert is counted from the folder of each file, so one destination serves files that sit in many folders.
tipMainOverwrite: What to do when the output file already exists
tipMainParallel: Files converted at the same time
tipMainApply: Apply these choices to the selected files
lblStgNotify: Show notification when conversion is finished
msgMainListEmpty: No files yet. Drag video files onto this window.
msgMainDropLabel: Drop video files to add them
msgMainNoFfmpeg: ffmpeg is not installed, so nothing can be converted. Open Settings to download it.
msgMngReorderHint: Drag an entry to change the order. The same order is used in the lists of the window.
msgPrsEncoderHint: H.264 and H.265 need an ffmpeg with x264 and x265. The one the app downloads has them.
msgPrsQualityHint: Lower is better and makes larger files.
tipMainSize: The largest picture size of the converted files
msgSizeHint: The picture is shrunk to fit inside this box and keeps its shape. It is never enlarged. Leave a side empty for no limit.
msgAudioHint: The window offers only the entries that the container of the chosen preset can hold. Original audio keeps the sound as it is when the container can hold it, and converts it when it cannot.
msgPrsAmdHint: These encoders run on an AMD graphics card and need its driver. They are fast, and the files are larger than with x264 or x265 at the same quality.
tipMainEffects: What is done to the picture: a turn, a watermark, text
tipFxDrag: Drag to change when this effect runs
msgPrsX265Hint: Passed to x265 as they are: key=value pairs joined by colons, as in -x265-params.
msgPrsRawHint: Uncompressed pictures make enormous files: about 9 GB a minute for full-HD video.
lblAudLoudness: Bring to a standard loudness (-16 LUFS)
msgPrsNvidiaHint: These encoders run on an NVIDIA graphics card and need its driver. They are fast, and the files are larger than with x264 or x265 at the same quality.
msgPrsIntelHint: These encoders run on Intel graphics (Quick Sync) and need its driver. They are fast, and the files are larger than with x264 or x265 at the same quality. Not every Intel chip has the H.265 encoder.
tipMainTrim: Keep only part of each file: the start and the end, in seconds (90), minutes:seconds (1:30) or hours:minutes:seconds. Empty keeps everything. Not saved.
msgMainTrimInvalid: The start and end times are not valid: use seconds or minutes:seconds, and the end must come after the start.
msgStgFfmpegCheckFailed: Could not reach yaiol to check for the latest version.
msgStgFfmpegExplain: Downloads ffmpeg {version} (about {size} MB) from {source} and installs it for all yaiol apps.
msgMetaNamesHint: One name per line, or several separated by ;. Case does not matter; * stands for any run of characters (location*). A name applies to the whole file, to every track and to every chapter. ffmpeg's own encoder tag and the file's technical fields are never touched.
msgFxNoCatalogue: The effects come with ffmpeg and are not installed yet. They are fetched together with ffmpeg when the app starts online.
